Rationale.CS1_Results_vs_Conclusion: All evaluable conclusions in documentation.pdf match the results stated in plan.md. The numerical results for WMDP erasure (Zephyr-7B: Bio 29.7%, Cyber 27.2%; Llama3-8B: Bio 33.3%, Cyber 26.6%), ablation study results (w/o Lerase: 64.8% Bio, w/o Lretain: 23.6% MMLU, w/o Lfluency: 29.8 R-PPL), and Harry Potter erasure results (ELM: 38.3% HP-MCQ, 45.3% MMLU, 3.4 R-PPL) are consistent between the plan file and the documentation PDF. The claimed MMLU scores for larger models (75.2-78.8%) also match Table 1 in the documentation.
Rationale.CS2_Plan_vs_Implementation: Plan file exists (plan.md) and all plan steps appear in the implementation. The methodology components are fully implemented: (1) Introspective classification with expert/novice prompts (positive_prompt_templates and negative_prompt_templates in erase.py), (2) Three loss terms - Lerase (lines 499-532), Lretain (lines 537-565), and Lfluency (lines 567-603), (3) LoRA adapters on early layers (LoraConfig with layers_to_transform, default layers 4-8), (4) Training data configurations for WMDP-Bio, WMDP-Cyber, and Harry Potter datasets with max 700 character length. All experiments described in the plan (WMDP concept erasure, ablation study, robustness testing, Harry Potter erasure, hyperparameter analysis) are supported by the implementation with configurable parameters via command-line arguments.
